texts.neh.3.14: And the dung-gate hath Malchijah son of Rechab, head of the district of Beth-Haccerem, strengthened; he doth built it, and set up its doors, its locks, and its bars.
texts.neh.3.15: And the gate of the fountain hath Shallum son of Col-Hozeh, head of the district of Mizpah, strengthened: he doth build it, and cover it, and set up its doors, its locks, and its bars, and the wall of the pool of Siloah, to the garden of the king, and unto the steps that are going down from the city of David.
texts.neh.3.16: After him hath Nehemiah son of Azbuk, head of the half of the district of Beth-Zur, strengthened, unto over-against the graves of David, and unto the pool that is made, and unto the house of the mighty ones.
texts.neh.3.17: After him have the Levites strengthened, [and] Rehum son of Bani: by his hand hath Hashabiah, head of the half of the district of Keilah, strengthened, for his district.
texts.neh.3.18: After him have their brethren strengthened, [and] Bavvai son of Henadad, head of the half of the district of Keilah.
texts.neh.3.19: And Ezer son of Jeshua, head of Mizpah, doth strengthen, by his hand, a second measure, from over-against the ascent of the armoury at the angle.
texts.neh.3.20: After him hath Baruch son of Zabbai hastened to strengthen a second measure from the angle unto the opening of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
texts.neh.3.21: After him hath Meremoth son of Urijah, son of Koz, strengthened, a second measure, from the opening of the house of Eliashib even unto the completion of the house of Eliashib.
texts.neh.3.22: And after him have the priests, men of the circuit, strengthened.
texts.neh.3.23: After them hath Benjamin strengthened, and Hashub, over-against their house; after him hath Azariah son of Maaseiah, son of Ananiah, strengthened, near his house.
texts.neh.3.24: After him hath Binnui son of Henadad strengthened, a second measure, from the house of Azariah unto the angle, and unto the corner.
texts.neh.3.25: Palal son of Uzai, from over-against the angle, and the tower that is going out from the upper house of the king that [is] at the court of the prison; after him Pedaiah son of Parosh.
texts.neh.3.26: And the Nethinim have been dwelling in Ophel, unto over-against the water-gate at the east, and the tower that goeth out.
texts.neh.3.27: After him have the Tekoites strengthened, a second measure, from over-against the great tower that goeth out, and unto the wall of Ophel.
texts.neh.3.28: From above the horse-gate have the priests strengthened, each over-against his house.
texts.neh.3.29: After them hath Zadok son of Immer strengthened, over against his house; and after him hath Shemaiah son of Shechaniah, keeper of the east gate, strengthened.
texts.neh.3.30: After him hath Hananiah son of Shelemiah strengthened, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, a second measure; after him hath Meshullam son of Berechiah strengthened, over-against his chamber.
texts.neh.3.31: After him hath Malchijah son of the refiner strengthened, unto the house of the Nethinim, and of the merchants, over-against the gate of the Miphkad, and unto the ascent of the corner.
texts.neh.3.32: And between the ascent of the corner and the sheep-gate, have the refiners and the merchants strengthened.
texts.neh.4.1: And it cometh to pass, when Sanballat hath heard that we are building the wall, that it is displeasing to him, and he is very angry and mocketh at the Jews,
texts.neh.4.2: and saith before his brethren and the force of Samaria, yea, he saith, `What [are] the weak Jews doing? are they left to themselves? do they sacrifice? do they complete in a day? do they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish? -- and they burnt!'
texts.neh.4.3: And Tobiah the Ammonite [is] by him and saith, `Also, that which they are building -- if a fox doth go up, then it hath broken down their stone wall.'
texts.neh.4.4: Hear, O our God, for we have been despised; and turn back their reproach on their own head, and give them for a spoil in a land of captivity;
texts.neh.4.5: and do not cover over their iniquity, and their sin from before Thee let not be blotted out, for they have provoked to anger -- over-against those building.
texts.neh.4.6: And we build the wall, and all the wall is joined -- unto its half, and the people have a heart to work.
texts.neh.4.7: And it cometh to pass, when Sanballat hath heard, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, that lengthening hath gone up to the walls of Jerusalem, that the breeches have begun to be stopped, then it is very displeasing to them,
texts.neh.4.8: and they conspire, all of them together, to come in to fight against Jerusalem, and to do to it injury.
texts.neh.4.9: And we pray unto our God, and appoint a watch against them, by day and by night, because of them.
texts.neh.4.10: And Judah saith, `The power of the burden-bearers hath become feeble, and the rubbish [is] abundant, and we are not able to build on the wall.'
texts.neh.4.11: And our adversaries say, `They do not know, nor see, till that we come in to their midst, and have slain them, and caused the work to cease.'
texts.neh.4.12: And it cometh to pass, when the Jews have come who are dwelling near them, that they say to us ten times from all the places whither ye return -- [they are] against us.
texts.neh.4.13: And I appoint at the lowest of the places, at the back of the wall, in the clear places, yea, I appoint the people, by their families, with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
texts.neh.4.14: And I see, and rise up, and say unto the freemen, and unto the prefects, and unto the rest of the people, `Be not afraid of them; the Lord, the great and the fearful, remember ye, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.'
texts.neh.4.15: And it cometh to pass, when our enemies have heard that it hath been known to us, and God doth frustrate their counsel, and we turn back, all of us, unto the wall, each unto his work;
texts.neh.4.16: yea, it cometh to pass, from that day, half of my servants are working in the business, and half of them are keeping hold of both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the coats of mail; and the heads [are] behind all the house of Judah.
texts.neh.4.17: The builders on the wall, and the bearers of the burden, those lading, [each] with one of his hands is working in the business, and one is laying hold of the missile.
texts.neh.4.18: And the builders [are] each with his sword, girded on his loins, and building, and he who is blowing with a trumpet [is] beside me.
texts.neh.4.19: And I say unto the freemen, and unto the prefects, and unto the rest of the people, `The work is abundant, and large, and we are separated on the wall, far off one from another;
texts.neh.4.20: in the place that ye hear the voice of the trumpet thither ye are gathered unto us; our God doth fight for us.'
texts.neh.4.21: And we are working in the business, and half of them are keeping hold of the spears, from the going up of the dawn till the coming forth of the stars.
texts.neh.4.22: Also, at that time I said to the people, `Let each with his servant lodge in the midst of Jerusalem, and they have been to us by night a guard, and by day [for] the work:'
texts.neh.4.23: and there are none -- I and my brethren and my servants, the men of the guard who [are] after me -- there are none of us putting off our garments, each [hath] his vessel of water.
texts.neh.5.1: And there is a great cry of the people and their wives, concerning their brethren the Jews,
texts.neh.5.2: yea, there are who are saying, `Our sons, and our daughters, we -- are many, and we receive corn, and eat, and live.'
texts.neh.5.3: And there are who are saying, `Our fields, and our vineyards, and our houses, we are pledging, and we receive corn for the famine.'
texts.neh.5.4: And there are who are saying, `We have borrowed money for the tribute of the king, [on] our fields, and our vineyards;
texts.neh.5.5: and now, as the flesh of our brethren [is] our flesh, as their sons [are] our sons, and lo, we are subduing our sons and our daughters for servants, and there are of our daughters subdued, and our hand hath no might, and our fields and our vineyards [are] to others.'
texts.neh.5.6: And it is very displeasing to me when I have heard their cry and these words,
texts.neh.5.7: and my heart reigneth over me, and I strive with the freemen, and with the prefects, and say to them, `Usury one upon another ye are exacting;' and I set against them a great assembly,
texts.neh.5.8: and say to them, `We have acquired our brethren the Jews, those sold to the nations, according to the ability that [is] in us, and ye also sell your brethren, and they have been sold to us!' and they are silent, and have not found a word.
texts.neh.5.9: And I say, `Not good [is] the thing that ye are doing; in the fear of our God do ye not walk, because of the reproach of the nations our enemies?
texts.neh.5.10: And also, I, my brethren, and my servants, are exacting of them silver and corn; let us leave off, I pray you, this usury.
texts.neh.5.11: Give back, I pray you, to them, as to-day, their fields, their vineyards, their olive-yards, and their houses, and the hundredth [part] of the money, and of the corn, of the new wine, and of the oil, that ye are exacting of them.'
texts.neh.5.12: And they say, `We give back, and of them we seek nothing; so we do as thou art saying.' And I call the priests, and cause them to swear to do according to this thing;
texts.neh.5.13: also, my lap I have shaken, and I say, `Thus doth God shake out every man, who doth not perform this thing, from his house, and from his labour; yea, thus is he shaken out and empty;' and all the assembly say, `Amen,' and praise Jehovah; and the people do according to this thing.
texts.neh.5.14: Also, from the day that he appointed me to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the thirty and second year of Artaxerxes the king -- twelve years -- I, and my brethren, the bread of the governor have not eaten:
texts.neh.5.15: the former governors who [are] before me have made themselves heavy on the people, and take of them in bread and wine, besides in silver forty shekels; also, their servants have ruled over the people -- and I have not done so, because of the fear of God.
texts.neh.5.16: And also, in the work of this wall I have done mightily, even a field we have not bought, and all my servants are gathered there for the work;
texts.neh.5.17: and of the Jews, and of the prefects, a hundred and fifty men, and those coming in unto us of the nations that [are] round about us, [are] at my table;
texts.neh.5.18: and that which hath been prepared for one day [is] one ox, six fat sheep, also fowls have been prepared for me, and once in ten days of all wines abundantly, and with this, the bread of the governor I have not sought, for heavy is the service on this people.
texts.neh.5.19: Remember for me, O my God, for good, all that I have done for this people.
texts.neh.6.1: And it cometh to pass, when it hath been heard by Sanballat, and Tobiah, and by Geshem the Arabian, and by the rest of our enemies, that I have builded the wall, and there hath not been left in it a breach, (also, till that time the doors I had not set up in the gates,)
texts.neh.6.2: that Sanballat sendeth, also Geshem, unto me, saying, `Come and we meet together in the villages, in the valley of Ono;' and they are thinking to do to me evil.
texts.neh.6.3: And I send unto them messengers, saying, `A great work I am doing, and I am not able to come down; why doth the work cease when I let it alone, and have come down unto you?'
texts.neh.6.4: and they send unto me, according to this word, four times, and I return them [word] according to this word.
texts.neh.6.5: And Sanballat sendeth unto me, according to this word, a fifth time, his servant, and an open letter in his hand;
texts.neh.6.6: it is written in it, `Among the nations it hath been heard, and Gashmu is saying: Thou and the Jews are thinking to rebel, therefore thou art building the wall, and thou hast been to them for a king -- according to these words!
texts.neh.6.7: And also, prophets thou hast appointed to call for thee in Jerusalem, saying, A king [is] in Judah, and now it is heard by the king according to these words; and now come, and we take counsel together.'
texts.neh.6.8: And I send unto him, saying, `It hath not been according to these words that thou art saying, for from thine own heart thou art devising them;'
texts.neh.6.9: for all of them are making us afraid, saying, `Their hands are too feeble for the work, and it is not done;' and now, strengthen Thou my hands.
texts.neh.6.10: And I have entered the house of Shemaiah son of Delaiah, son of Mehetabeel -- and he is restrained -- and he saith, `Let us meet at the house of God, at the inside of the temple, and we shut the doors of the temple, for they are coming in to slay thee -- yea, by night they are coming in to slay thee.'
texts.neh.6.11: And I say, `A man such as I -- doth he flee? and who as I, that doth go in unto the temple, and live? -- I do not go in.'
texts.neh.6.12: And I discern, and lo, God hath not sent him, for in the prophecy he hath spoken unto me both Tobiah and Sanballat hired him,
texts.neh.6.13: so that he [is] an hireling, that I may fear and do so, and I had sinned, and it had been to them for an evil name that they may reproach me.
texts.neh.6.14: Be mindful, O my God, of Tobiah, and of Sanballat, according to these his works, and also, of Noadiah the prophetess, and of the rest of the prophets who have been making me afraid.
texts.neh.6.15: And the wall is completed in the twenty and fifth of Elul, on the fifty and second day;
texts.neh.6.16: and it cometh to pass, when all our enemies have heard, and all the nations who are round about us see, that they fall greatly in their own eyes, and know that by our God hath this work been done.
texts.neh.6.17: Also, in those days the freemen of Judah are multiplying their letters going unto Tobiah, and those of Tobiah are coming in unto them;
texts.neh.6.18: for many in Judah are sworn to him, for he [is] son-in-law to Shechaniah son of Arah, and Jehohanan his son hath taken the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah;
texts.neh.6.19: also, his good deeds they have been saying before me, and my words they have been taking out to him; letters hath Tobiah sent to make me afraid.
texts.neh.7.1: And it cometh to pass, when the wall hath been built, that I set up the doors, and the gatekeepers are appointed, and the singers, and the Levites,
texts.neh.7.2: and I charge Hanani my brother, and Hananiah head of the palace, concerning Jerusalem -- for he [is] as a man of truth, and fearing God above many --
texts.neh.7.3: and I say to them, `Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened till the heat of the sun, and while they are standing by let them shut the doors, and fasten, and appoint guards of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, each in his guard, and each over-against his house.'
texts.neh.7.4: And the city [is] broad on both sides, and great, and the people [are] few in its midst, and there are no houses builded;
texts.neh.7.5: and my God putteth it unto my heart, and I gather the freeman, and the prefects, and the people, for the genealogy, and I find a book of the genealogy of those coming up at the beginning, and I find written in it: --
texts.neh.7.6: These [are] sons of the province, those coming up of the captives of the removal that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon removed -- and they turn back to Jerusalem and to Judah, each to his city --
texts.neh.7.7: who are coming in with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. Number of the men of the people of Israel:
texts.neh.7.8: Sons of Parosh: two thousand a hundred and seventy and two.
texts.neh.7.9: Sons of Shephatiah: three hundred seventy and two.
texts.neh.7.10: Sons of Arah: six hundred fifty and two.
texts.neh.7.11: Sons of Pahath-Moab, of the sons of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand and eight hundred [and] eighteen.
texts.neh.7.12: Sons of Elam: a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
texts.neh.7.13: Sons of Zattu: eight hundred forty and five.
texts.neh.7.14: Sons of Zaccai: seven hundred and sixty.
texts.neh.7.15: Sons of Binnui: six hundred forty and eight.
texts.neh.7.16: Sons of Bebai: six hundred twenty and eight.
texts.neh.7.17: Sons of Azgad: two thousand three hundred twenty and two.
texts.neh.7.18: Sons of Adonikam: six hundred sixty and seven.
texts.neh.7.19: Sons of Bigvai: two thousand sixty and seven.
texts.neh.7.20: Sons of Adin: six hundred fifty and five.
texts.neh.7.21: Sons of Ater of Hezekiah: ninety and eight.
texts.neh.7.22: Sons of Hashum: three hundred twenty and eight.
texts.neh.7.23: Sons of Bezai: three hundred twenty and four.
texts.neh.7.24: Sons of Hariph: a hundred [and] twelve.
texts.neh.7.25: Sons of Gibeon: ninety and five.
texts.neh.7.26: Men of Beth-Lehem and Netophah: a hundred eighty and eight.
texts.neh.7.27: Men of Anathoth: a hundred twenty and eight.
texts.neh.7.28: Men of Beth-Azmaveth: forty and two.
texts.neh.7.29: Men of Kirjath-Jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth: seven hundred forty and three.
texts.neh.7.30: Men of Ramah and Gaba: six hundred twenty and one.
texts.neh.7.31: Men of Michmas: a hundred and twenty and two.
texts.neh.7.32: Men of Bethel and Ai: a hundred twenty and three.
texts.neh.7.33: Men of the other Nebo: fifty and two.
texts.neh.7.34: Sons of the other Elam: a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
texts.neh.7.35: Sons of Harim: three hundred and twenty.
texts.neh.7.36: Sons of Jericho: three hundred forty and five.
texts.neh.7.37: Sons of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: seven hundred and twenty and one.
texts.neh.7.38: Sons of Senaah: three thousand nine hundred and thirty.
texts.neh.7.39: The priests: sons of Jedaiah: of the house of Jeshua: nine hundred seventy and three;
texts.neh.7.40: sons of Immer: a thousand fifty and two;
texts.neh.7.41: sons of Pashur: a thousand two hundred forty and seven;
texts.neh.7.42: sons of Harim: a thousand and seventeen.
texts.neh.7.43: The Levites: sons of Jeshua, of Kadmiel: of sons of Hodevah: seventy and four.
texts.neh.7.44: The singers: sons of Asaph: a hundred forty and eight.
texts.neh.7.45: The gatekeepers: sons of Shallum, sons of Ater, sons of Talmon, sons of Akkub, sons of Hatita, sons of Shobai: a hundred thirty and eight.
texts.neh.7.46: The Nethinim: sons of Ziha, sons of Hasupha, sons of Tabbaoth,
texts.neh.7.47: sons of Keros, sons of Sia, sons of Padon,
texts.neh.7.48: sons of Lebanah, sons of Hagaba, sons of Shalmai,
texts.neh.7.49: sons of Hanan, sons of Giddel, sons of Gahar,
texts.neh.7.50: sons of Reaiah, sons of Rezin, sons of Nekoda,
texts.neh.7.51: sons of Gazzam, sons of Uzza, sons of Phaseah,
texts.neh.7.52: sons of Bezai, sons of Meunim, sons of Nephishesim,
texts.neh.7.53: sons of Bakbuk, sons of Hakupha, sons of Harhur,
texts.neh.7.54: sons of Bazlith, sons of Mehida, sons of Harsha,
texts.neh.7.55: sons of Barkos, sons of Sisera, sons of Tamah,
texts.neh.7.56: sons of Neziah, sons of Hatipha.
texts.neh.7.57: Sons of the servants of Solomon: sons of Sotai, sons of Sophereth, sons of Perida,
texts.neh.7.58: sons of Jaala, sons of Darkon, sons of Giddel,
texts.neh.7.59: sons of Shephatiah, sons of Hattil, sons of Pochereth of Zebaim, sons of Amon.
texts.neh.7.60: All the Nethinim and the sons of the servants of Solomon [are] three hundred ninety and two.
texts.neh.7.61: And these [are] those coming up from Tel-Melah, Tel-Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer -- and they have not been able to declare the house of their fathers, and their seed, whether they [are] of Israel --
texts.neh.7.62: sons of Delaiah, sons of Tobiah, sons of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.
texts.neh.7.63: And of the priests: sons of Habaiah sons of Koz, sons of Barzillai, who hath taken from the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite a wife, and is called by their name.
texts.neh.7.64: These have sought their register among those reckoning themselves by genealogy, and it hath not been found, and they are redeemed from the priesthood,
texts.neh.7.65: and the Tirshatha saith to them that they eat not of the most holy things till the standing up of the priest with Urim and Thummim.
texts.neh.7.66: All the assembly together [is] four myriads two thousand three hundred and sixty,
texts.neh.7.67: apart from their servants and their handmaids -- these [are] seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven; and of them [are] singers and songstresses, two hundred forty and five.
texts.neh.7.68: Their horses [are] seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred [and] forty and five;
texts.neh.7.69: camels, four hundred thirty and five; asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
texts.neh.7.70: And from the extremity of the heads of the fathers they have given to the work; the Tirshatha hath given to the treasure, of gold, drams a thousand, bowls fifty, priests' coats thirty and five hundred.
texts.neh.7.71: And of the heads of the fathers they have given to the treasure of the work, of gold, drams two myriads, and of silver, pounds two thousand and two hundred.
texts.neh.7.72: And that which the rest of the people have given [is] of gold, drams two myriads, and of silver, pounds two thousand, and of priests coats, sixty and seven.
texts.neh.7.73: And they dwell -- the priests, and the Levites, and the gatekeepers, and the singers, and [some] of the people, and the Nethinim, and all Israel -- in their cities, and the seventh month cometh, and the sons of Israel [are] in their cities.
texts.neh.8.1: And all the people are gathered as one man unto the broad place that [is] before the water-gate, and they say to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, that Jehovah commanded Israel.
texts.neh.8.2: And Ezra the priest bringeth the law before the assembly, both of men and women, and every one intelligent to hear, on the first day of the seventh month,
texts.neh.8.3: and he readeth in it before the broad place that [is] before the water-gate, from the light till the middle of the day, over-against the men, and the women, and those intelligent, and the ears of all the people [are] unto the book of the law.
texts.neh.8.4: And Ezra the scribe standeth on a tower of wood that they made for the purpose, and Mattithiah standeth near him, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right; and on his left Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchijah, and Hashum, and Hashbaddana, Zechariah, Meshullam.
texts.neh.8.5: And Ezra openeth the book before the eyes of all the people -- for above all the people he hath been -- and at his opening [it] all the people have stood up,
texts.neh.8.6: and Ezra blesseth Jehovah, the great God, and all the people answer, `Amen, Amen,' with lifting up of their hands, and they bow and do obeisance to Jehovah -- faces to the earth.
texts.neh.8.7: And Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, giving the people understanding in the law, and the people, [are] on their station,
texts.neh.8.8: and they read in the book, in the law of God, explaining -- so as to give the meaning, and they give understanding to the convocation.
texts.neh.8.9: And Nehemiah -- he [is] the Tirshatha -- saith (and Ezra the priest, the scribe, and the Levites who are instructing the people) to all the people, `To-day is holy to Jehovah your God, do not mourn, nor weep:' for all the people are weeping at their hearing the words of the law.
texts.neh.8.10: And he saith to them, `Go, eat fat things, and drink sweet things, and sent portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for to-day [is] holy to our Lord, and be not grieved, for the joy of Jehovah is your strength.'
texts.neh.8.11: And the Levites are keeping all the people silent, saying, `Be silent, for to-day [is] holy, and be not grieved.'
texts.neh.8.12: And all the people go to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great joy, because they have understood concerning the words that they made known to them.
texts.neh.8.13: And on the second day have been gathered heads of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to act wisely concerning the words of the law.
texts.neh.8.14: And they find written in the law that Jehovah commanded by the hand of Moses, that the sons of Israel dwell in booths in the feast, in the seventh month,
texts.neh.8.15: and that they proclaim and cause to pass over all their cities, (and in Jerusalem,) saying, `Go ye out to the mount, and bring leaves of the olive, and leaves of the oil tree, and leaves of the myrtle, and leaves of the palms, and leaves of thick trees, to make booths as it is written.'
texts.neh.8.16: And the people go out, and bring in, and make for themselves booths, each on his roof, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the broad place of the water-gate, and in the broad place of the gate of Ephraim.
texts.neh.8.17: And they make -- all the assembly of the captives of the captivity -- booths, and they sit in booths; for the sons of Israel had not done, from the days of Jeshua son of Nun, so unto that day, and there is very great joy.
texts.neh.8.18: And he readeth in the book of the law of God day by day, from the first day till the last day, and they make a feast seven days, and on the eighth day a restraint, according to the ordinance.
texts.neh.9.1: And in the twenty and fourth day of this month have the sons of Israel been gathered, with fasting, and with sackcloth, and earth upon them;
texts.neh.9.2: and the seed of Israel are separated from all sons of a stranger, and stand and confess concerning their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers,
texts.neh.9.3: and rise up on their station, and read in the book of the law of Jehovah their God a fourth of the day, and a fourth they are confessing and bowing themselves to Jehovah their God.
texts.neh.9.4: And there stand up on the ascent, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, Chenani, and they cry with a loud voice unto Jehovah their God.
texts.neh.9.5: And the Levites say, [even] Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, Pethahiah, `Rise, bless Jehovah your God, from the age unto the age, and they bless the name of Thine honour that [is] exalted above all blessing and praise.
texts.neh.9.6: Thou [art] He, O Jehovah, Thyself -- Thou hast made the heavens, the heavens of the heavens, and all their host, the earth and all that [are] on it, the seas and all that [are] in them, and Thou art keeping all of them alive, and the host of the heavens to Thee are bowing themselves.
texts.neh.9.7: `Thou [art] He, O Jehovah God, who didst fix on Abraham, and didst bring him out from Ur of the Chaldeans, and didst make his name Abraham,
texts.neh.9.8: and didst find his heart stedfast before Thee, so as to make with him the covenant, to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give [it] to his seed. `And Thou dost establish Thy words, for Thou [art] righteous,
texts.neh.9.9: and dost see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and their cry hast heard by the sea of Suph,
texts.neh.9.10: and dost give signs and wonders on Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land, for Thou hast known that they have acted proudly against them, and Thou makest to Thee a name as [at] this day.
texts.neh.9.11: And the sea Thou hast cleaved before them, and they pass over into the midst of the sea on the dry land, and their pursuers Thou hast cast into the depths, as a stone, into the strong waters.
texts.neh.9.12: And by a pillar of cloud Thou hast led them by day, and by a pillar of fire by night, to lighten to them the way in which they go.
texts.neh.9.13: `And on mount Sinai Thou hast come down, even to speak with them from the heavens, and Thou dost give to them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commands.
texts.neh.9.14: And Thy holy sabbath Thou hast made known to them, and commands, and statutes, and law, Thou hast commanded for them, by the hand of Moses Thy servant;
texts.neh.9.15: and bread from the heavens Thou hast given to them for their hunger, and water from a rock hast brought out to them for their thirst, and dost say to them to go in to possess the land that Thou hast lifted up Thy hand to give to them.
texts.neh.9.16: `And they and our fathers have acted proudly, and harden their neck, and have not hearkened unto Thy commands,
texts.neh.9.17: yea, they refuse to hearken, and have not remembered Thy wonders that Thou hast done with them, and harden their neck and appoint a head, to turn back to their service, in their rebellion; and Thou [art] a God of pardons, gracious, and merciful, long-suffering, and abundant in kindness, and hast not forsaken them.
texts.neh.9.18: `Also, when they have made to themselves a molten calf, and say, this [is] thy god that brought thee up out of Egypt, and do great despisings,
texts.neh.9.19: and Thou, in Thine abundant mercies, hast not forsaken them in the wilderness -- the pillar of the cloud hath not turned aside from off them by day, to lead them in the way, and the pillar of the fire by night, to give light to them and the way in which they go.
texts.neh.9.20: `And Thy good Spirit Thou hast given, to cause them to act wisely; and Thy manna Thou hast not withheld from their mouth, and water Thou hast given to them for their thirst,
texts.neh.9.21: and forty years Thou hast nourished them in a wilderness; they have not lacked; their garments have not worn out, and their feet have not swelled.
texts.neh.9.22: `And Thou givest to them kingdoms, and peoples, and dost apportion them to the corner, and they possess the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
texts.neh.9.23: And their sons Thou hast multiplied as the stars of the heavens, and bringest them in unto the land that Thou hast said to their fathers to go in to possess.
texts.neh.9.24: `And the sons come in, and possess the land, and Thou humblest before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and givest them into their hand, and their kings, and the peoples of the land, to do with them according to their pleasure.
texts.neh.9.25: And they capture fenced cities, and fat ground, and possess houses full of all good, digged-wells, vineyards, and olive-yards, and fruit-trees in abundance, and they eat, and are satisfied, and become fat, and delight themselves in Thy great goodness.
texts.neh.9.26: `And they are disobedient, and rebel against Thee, and cast Thy law behind their back, and Thy prophets they have slain, who testified against them, to bring them back unto Thee, and they do great despisings,
texts.neh.9.27: and Thou givest them into the hand of their adversaries, and they distress them, and in the time of their distress they cry unto Thee, and Thou, from the heavens, dost hear, and, according to Thine abundant mercies, dost give to them saviours, and they save them out of the hand of their adversaries.
texts.neh.9.28: `And when they have rest, they turn back to do evil before Thee, and Thou dost leave them in the hand of their enemies, and they rule over them; and they turn back, and call Thee, and Thou from the heavens dost hear, and dost deliver them, according to Thy mercies, many times,
texts.neh.9.29: and dost testify against them, to bring them back unto Thy law; and they -- they have acted proudly, and have not hearkened to Thy commands, and against Thy judgments have sinned, -- which man doth and hath lived in them -- and they give a refractory shoulder, and their neck have hardened, and have not hearkened.
texts.neh.9.30: `And Thou drawest over them many years, and testifiest against them by Thy Spirit, by the hand of Thy prophets, and they have not given ear, and Thou dost give them into the hand of peoples of the lands,
texts.neh.9.31: and in Thine abundant mercies Thou hast not made them a consumption, nor hast forsaken them; for a God, gracious and merciful, [art] Thou.
texts.neh.9.32: `And now, O our God -- God, the great, the mighty, and the fearful, keeping the covenant and the kindness -- let not all the travail that hath found us be little before Thee, for our kings, for our heads, and for our priests, and for our prophets, and for our fathers, and for all Thy people, from the days of the kings of Asshur unto this day;
texts.neh.9.33: and Thou [art] righteous concerning all that hath come upon us, for truth Thou hast done, and we have done wickedly;
texts.neh.9.34: and our kings, our heads, our priests, and our fathers, have not done Thy law, nor attended unto Thy commands, and to Thy testimonies, that Thou hast testified against them;
texts.neh.9.35: and they, in their kingdom, and in Thine abundant goodness, that Thou hast given to them, and in the land, the large and the fat, that Thou hast set before them, have not served Thee, nor turned back from their evil doings.
texts.neh.9.36: `Lo, we -- to-day -- [are] servants, and the land that Thou hast given to our fathers, to eat its fruit and its good -- lo, we [are] servants on it,
texts.neh.9.37: and its increase it is multiplying to the kings whom Thou hast set over us in our sins; and over our bodies they are ruling, and over our cattle, according to their pleasure, and we [are] in great distress.
texts.neh.9.38: And for all this we are making a stedfast covenant, and are writing, and over him who is sealed [are] our heads, our Levites, our priests.'
texts.neh.10.1: And over those sealed [are] Nehemiah the Tirshatha, son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,
texts.neh.10.8: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah; these [are] the priests.
texts.neh.10.9: And the Levites: both Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;
texts.neh.10.10: and their brethren: Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
texts.neh.10.14: Heads of the people: Parosh, Pahath-Moab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,
texts.neh.10.28: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the Nethinim, and every one who hath been separated from the peoples of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every knowing intelligent one,
texts.neh.10.29: are laying hold on their brethren, their honourable ones, and coming in to an execration, and in to an oath, to walk in the law of God, that was given by the hand of Moses, servant of God, and to observe and to do all the commands of Jehovah our Lord, and His judgments, and His statutes;
texts.neh.10.30: and that we give not our daughters to the peoples of the land, and their daughters we take not to our sons;
texts.neh.10.31: and the peoples of the land who are bringing in the wares and any corn on the sabbath-day to sell, we receive not of them on the sabbath, and on a holy day, and we leave the seventh year, and usury on every hand.
texts.neh.10.32: And we have appointed for ourselves commands, to put on ourselves the third of a shekel in a year, for the service of the house of our God,
texts.neh.10.33: for bread of the arrangement, and the continual present, and the continual burnt-offering of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for appointed seasons, and for holy things, and for sin-offerings, to make atonement for Israel, even all the work of the house of our God.
texts.neh.10.34: And the lots we have caused to fall for the offering of wood, [among] the priests, the Levites, and the people, to bring in to the house of our God, by the house of our fathers, at times appointed, year by year, to burn on the altar of Jehovah our God, as it is written in the law,
texts.neh.10.35: and to bring in the first fruits of our ground, and the first fruits of all fruit of every tree, year by year, to the house of Jehovah,
texts.neh.10.36: and the firstlings of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and our flocks, to bring in to the house of our God, to the priests who are ministering in the house of our God.
texts.neh.10.37: And the beginning of our dough, and our heave-offerings, and the fruit of every tree, of new wine, and of oil, we bring in to the priests, unto the chambers of the house of our God, and the tithe of our ground to the Levites; and they -- the Levites -- have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage;
texts.neh.10.38: and the priest, son of Aaron, hath been with the Levites in the tithing of the Levites, and the Levites bring up the tithe of the tithe to the house of our God unto the chambers, to the treasure-house;
texts.neh.10.39: for unto the chambers do they bring in -- the sons of Israel and the sons of Levi -- the heave-offering of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, and there [are] vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests, those ministering, and the gatekeepers, and the singers, and we do not forsake the house of our God.
texts.neh.11.1: And the heads of the people dwell in Jerusalem, and the rest of the people have caused to fall lots to bring in one out of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts in the cities,
texts.neh.11.2: and the people give a blessing to all the men who are offering themselves willingly to dwell in Jerusalem.
texts.neh.11.3: And these [are] heads of the province who have dwelt in Jerusalem, and in cities of Judah, they have dwelt each in his possession in their cities; Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinim, and the sons of the servants of Solomon.
texts.neh.11.4: And in Jerusalem have dwelt of the sons of Judah, and of the sons of Benjamin. Of the sons of Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah, son of Zechariah, son of Amariah, son of Shephatiah, son of Mahalaleel, of the sons of Perez;
texts.neh.11.5: and Masseiah son of Baruch, son of Col-Hozeh, son of Hazaiah, son of Adaiah, son of Joiarib, son of Zechariah, son of Shiloni;
texts.neh.11.6: all the sons of Perez who are dwelling in Jerusalem [are] four hundred sixty and eight, men of valour.
texts.neh.11.7: And these [are] sons of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Joed, son of Pedaiah, son of Kolaiah, son of Maaseiah, son of Ithiel, son of Jesaiah;
texts.neh.11.8: and after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
texts.neh.11.9: And Joel son of Zichri [is] inspector over them, and Judah son of Senuah [is] over the city -- second.
texts.neh.11.10: Of the priests: Jedaiah son of Joiarib, Jachin,
texts.neh.11.11: Seraiah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, leader of the house of God,
texts.neh.11.12: and their brethren doing the work of the house [are] eight hundred twenty and two; and Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pelaliah, son of Amzi, son of Zechariah, son of Pashhur, son of Malchiah,
texts.neh.11.13: and his brethren, heads of fathers, two hundred forty and two; and Amashsai son of Azareel, son of Ahazai, son of Meshillemoth, son of Immer,
texts.neh.11.14: and their brethren, mighty of valour, a hundred twenty and eight; and an inspector over them [is] Zabdiel, son of [one of] the great men.
texts.neh.11.15: And of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hashub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, son of Bunni,
texts.neh.11.16: and Shabbethai, and Jozabad, [are] over the outward work of the house of God, of the heads of the Levites,
texts.neh.11.17: and Mattaniah son of Micha, son of Zabdi, son of Asaph, [is] head -- at the commencement he giveth thanks in prayer; and Bakbukiah [is] second among his brethren, and Abda son of Shammua, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun.
texts.neh.11.18: All the Levites, in the holy city, [are] two hundred eighty and four.
texts.neh.11.19: And the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren, those watching at the gates, [are] a hundred seventy and two.
texts.neh.11.20: And the rest of Israel, of the priests, of the Levites, [are] in all cities of Judah, each in his inheritance;
texts.neh.11.21: and the Nethinim are dwelling in Ophel, and Ziha and Gishpa [are] over the Nethinim.
texts.neh.11.22: And the overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem [is] Uzzi son of Bani, son of Hashabiah, son of Mattaniah, son of Micha: of the sons of Asaph, the singers [are] over-against the work of the house of God,
texts.neh.11.23: for the command of the king [is] upon them, and support [is] for the singers, a matter of a day in its day.
texts.neh.11.24: And Pethahiah son of Meshezabeel, of the sons of Zerah, son of Judah, [is] by the hand of the king, for every matter of the people.
texts.neh.11.25: And at the villages with their fields, of the sons of Judah there have dwelt, in Kirjath-Arba and its small towns, and in Dibon and its small towns, and in Jekabzeel and its villages,
texts.neh.11.26: and in Jeshua, and in Moladah, and in Beth-Phelet,
texts.neh.11.27: and in Hazar-Shaul, and in Beer-Sheba and its small towns,
texts.neh.11.28: and in Ziklag, and in Mekonah and in its small towns,
texts.neh.11.29: and En-Rimmon, and in Zareah, and in Jarmuth,
texts.neh.11.30: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, Azekah and its small towns; and they encamp from Beer-Sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
texts.neh.11.31: And sons of Benjamin [are] at Geba, Michmash, and Aija, and Beth-El, and its small towns,
texts.neh.11.35: Lod, and Ono, the valley of the artificers.
texts.neh.11.36: And of the Levites, the courses of Judah [are] for Benjamin.
texts.neh.12.1: And these [are] the priests and the Levites who came up with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua; Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
texts.neh.12.7: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah; these [are] heads of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.
texts.neh.12.8: And the Levites [are] Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, Mattaniah, he [is] over the thanksgiving, and his brethren,
texts.neh.12.9: and Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, [are] over-against them in charges.
texts.neh.12.10: And Jeshua hath begotten Joiakim, and Joiakim hath begotten Eliashib, and Eliashib hath begotten Joiada,
texts.neh.12.11: and Joiada hath begotten Jonathan, and Jonathan hath begotten Jaddua.
texts.neh.12.12: And in the days of Joiakim have been priests, heads of the fathers; of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
texts.neh.12.13: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
texts.neh.12.14: of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;
texts.neh.12.15: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
texts.neh.12.16: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
texts.neh.12.17: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin; of Moadiah, Piltai;
texts.neh.12.18: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
texts.neh.12.19: and of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
texts.neh.12.20: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
texts.neh.12.21: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.
texts.neh.12.22: The Levites, in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, are written, heads of fathers, and of the priests, in the kingdom of Darius the Persian.
texts.neh.12.23: Sons of Levi, heads of the fathers, are written on the book of the Chronicles even till the days of Johanan son of Eliashib;
texts.neh.12.24: and heads of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their brethren, [are] over-against them, to give praise, to give thanks, by command of David the man of God, charge over-against charge.
texts.neh.12.25: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, [are] gatekeepers, keeping charge in the gatherings of the gates.
texts.neh.12.26: These [are] in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua, son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
texts.neh.12.27: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them in to Jerusalem, to make the dedication even with gladness, and with thanksgivings, and with singing, [with] cymbals, psalteries, and with harps;
texts.neh.12.28: and sons of the singers are gathered together even from the circuit round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi,
texts.neh.12.29: and from the house of Gilgal, and from fields of Geba and Azmaveth, for villages have the singers built for themselves round about Jerusalem;
texts.neh.12.30: and the priests and the Levites are cleansed, and they cleanse the people, and the gates, and the wall.
texts.neh.12.31: And I bring up the heads of Judah upon the wall, and appoint two great thanksgiving companies and processions. At the right, on the wall, to the dung-gate;
texts.neh.12.32: and after them goeth Hoshaiah, and half of the heads of Judah,
texts.neh.12.34: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah;
texts.neh.12.35: and of the sons of the priests with trumpets, Zechariah son of Jonathan, son of Shemaiah, son of Mattaniah, son of Michaiah, son of Zaccur, son of Asaph,
texts.neh.12.36: and his brethren Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with instruments of song of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe [is] before them;
texts.neh.12.37: and by the gate of the fountain and over-against them, they have gone up by the steps of the city of David, at the going up of the wall beyond the house of David, and unto the water-gate eastward.
texts.neh.12.38: And the second thanksgiving company that is going over-against, and I after it, and half of the people on the wall from beyond the tower of the furnaces and unto the broad wall,
texts.neh.12.39: and from beyond the gate of Ephraim, and by the old-gate, and by the fish-gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, and unto the sheep-gate -- and they have stood at the prison-gate.
texts.neh.12.40: And the two thanksgiving companies stand in the house of God, and I and half of the prefects with me,
texts.neh.12.41: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, Hananiah, with trumpets,
texts.neh.12.42: and Masseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer, and the singers sound, and Jezrahiah the inspector;
texts.neh.12.43: and they sacrifice on that day great sacrifices and rejoice, for God hath made them rejoice [with] great joy, and also, the women and the children have rejoiced, and the joy of Jerusalem is heard -- unto a distance.
texts.neh.12.44: And certain are appointed on that day over the chambers for treasures, for heave-offerings, for first-fruits, and for tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for priests, and for Levites, for the joy of Judah [is] over the priests, and over the Levites, who are standing up.
texts.neh.12.45: And the singers and the gatekeepers keep the charge of their God, even the charge of the cleansing -- according to the command of David [and] Solomon his son,
texts.neh.12.46: for in the days of David and Asaph of old [were] heads of the singers, and a song of praise and thanksgiving to God.
texts.neh.12.47: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, are giving the portions of the singers, and of the gatekeepers, the matter of a day in its day, and are sanctifying to the Levites, and the Levites are sanctifying to the sons of Aaron.
texts.neh.13.1: On that day there was read in the book of Moses, in the ears of the people, and it hath been found written in it that an Ammonite and Moabite doth not come into the assembly of God -- unto the age,
texts.neh.13.2: because they have not come before the sons of Israel with bread and with water, and hire against them Balaam to revile them, and our God turneth the reviling into a blessing.
texts.neh.13.3: And it cometh to pass, at their hearing the law, that they separate all the mixed people from Israel.
texts.neh.13.4: And before this Eliashib the priest, appointed over chambers of the house of our God, [is] a relation of Tobiah,
texts.neh.13.5: and he maketh for him a great chamber, and there they were formerly putting the present, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithe of the corn, the new wine, and the oil -- the commanded thing of the Levites, and the singers, and the gatekeepers -- and the heave-offering of the priests.
texts.neh.13.6: And during all this I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty and second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon did I come unto the king, and at the end of days I have asked of the king,
texts.neh.13.7: and I come in to Jerusalem, and understand concerning the evil that Eliashib hath done for Tobiah, to make to him a chamber in the courts of the house of God,
texts.neh.13.8: and it is very displeasing to me, and I cast all the vessels of the house of Tobiah without, out of the chamber,
texts.neh.13.9: and I speak, and they cleanse the chambers, and I bring back thither the vessels of the house of God with the present and the frankincense.
texts.neh.13.10: And I know that the portions of the Levites have not been given, and they flee each to his field -- the Levites and the singers, doing the work.
texts.neh.13.11: And I strive with the prefects, and say, `Wherefore hath the house of God been forsaken?' and I gather them, and set them on their station;
texts.neh.13.12: and all Judah have brought in the tithe of the corn, and of the new wine, and of the oil, to the treasuries.
texts.neh.13.13: And I appoint treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and Pedaiah of the Levites; and by their hand [is] Hanan son of Zaccur, son of Mattaniah, for stedfast they have been reckoned, and on them [it is] to give a portion to their brethren.
texts.neh.13.14: Be mindful of me, O my God, for this, and do not blot out my kind acts that I have done, for the house of my God, and for its charges.
texts.neh.13.15: In those days I have seen in Judah those treading wine-vats on sabbath, and bringing in the sheaves, and lading on the asses, and also, wine, grapes, and figs, and every burden, yea, they are bringing in to Jerusalem on the sabbath-day, and I testify in the day of their selling provision.
texts.neh.13.16: And the Tyrians have dwelt in it, bringing in fish, and every ware, and selling on sabbath to the sons of Judah and in Jerusalem.
texts.neh.13.17: And I strive with the freemen of Judah, and say to them, `What [is] this evil thing that ye are doing, and polluting the sabbath-day?
texts.neh.13.18: Thus did not your fathers do? and our God bringeth in on us all this evil, and on this city, and ye are adding fierceness on Israel, to pollute the sabbath.'
texts.neh.13.19: And it cometh to pass, when the gates of Jerusalem have been dark before the sabbath, that I speak, and the doors are shut, and I say, that they do not open them till after the sabbath; and of my servants I have stationed at the gates; there doth not come in a burden on the sabbath-day.
texts.neh.13.20: And they lodge -- the merchants and sellers of all ware -- at the outside of Jerusalem, once or twice,
texts.neh.13.21: and I testify against them, and say unto them, `Wherefore are ye lodging over-against the wall? if ye repeat [it], a hand I put forth upon you;' from that time they have not come in on the sabbath.
texts.neh.13.22: And I say to the Levites, that they be cleansed, and, coming in, keeping the gates, to sanctify the sabbath-day. Also, this, remember for me, O my God, and have pity on me, according to the abundance of Thy kindness.
texts.neh.13.23: Also, in those days, I have seen the Jews [who] have settled women of Ashdod, of Ammon, of Moab.
texts.neh.13.24: And of their sons, half are speaking Ashdoditish -- and are not knowing to speak Jewish -- and according to the language of people and people.
texts.neh.13.25: And I strive with them, and declare them vile, and smite certain of them, and pluck off their hair, and cause them to swear by God, `Ye do not give your daughters to their sons, nor do ye take of their daughters to your sons, and to yourselves.
texts.neh.13.26: `By these did not Solomon king of Israel sin? and among the many nations there was no king like him, and beloved by his God he was, and God maketh him king over all Israel -- even him did the strange women cause to sin.
texts.neh.13.27: And to you do we hearken to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God, to settle strange women?'
texts.neh.13.28: And [one] of the sons of Joiada son of Eliashib the high priest, [is] son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite, and I cause him to flee from off me.
texts.neh.13.29: Be mindful of them, O my God, for the redeemed of the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.
texts.neh.13.30: And I have cleansed them from every stranger, and appoint charges to priests and to Levites, each in his work,
texts.neh.13.31: and for the wood-offering at appointed times, and for first-fruits. Be mindful of me, O my God, for good.

texts.neh.1.1: Las palabras de Nehemías, hijo de Hequelías. Y fue en el mes de Casleu, en el año veinte, yo estaba en Susán, la cabecera del reino.
texts.neh.1.2: Y vino Janani, uno de mis hermanos, él y otros varones de Judá: y preguntéles por los Judíos escapados, que habían quedado de la cautividad, y por Jerusalem.
texts.neh.1.3: Y dijéronme: La resta, los que quedaron de la cautividad allí en la provincia, están en gran mal y vergüenza: y el muro de Jerusalem derribado, y sus puertas quemadas a fuego.
texts.neh.1.4: Y fue, que como yo oí estas palabras, sentéme, y lloré, y enlutéme por algunos días; y ayuné, y oré delante del Dios de los cielos,
texts.neh.1.5: Y dije: Ruego, oh Jehová, Dios de los cielos, fuerte, grande, y terrible, que guarda el concierto y la misericordia a los que le aman, y guardan sus mandamientos:
texts.neh.1.6: Sea ahora tu oído atento, y tus ojos abiertos, para oír la oración de tu siervo, que yo oro delante de ti hoy, día y noche, por los hijos de Israel tus siervos, y confieso los pecados de los hijos de Israel que pecamos contra ti: y yo, y la casa de mi padre hemos pecado:
texts.neh.1.7: Rebelando nos hemos rebelado, y apostatado de ti, y no hemos guardado los mandamientos, y estatutos, y juicios, que mandaste a Moisés tu siervo.
texts.neh.1.8: Acuérdate ahora de la palabra que mandaste a Moisés tu siervo, diciendo: Vosotros prevaricaréis, y yo os esparciré en los pueblos:
texts.neh.1.9: Y volveros heis a mí, y guardaréis mis mandamientos, y los haréis. Si fuere vuestro alanzamiento hasta el cabo de los cielos, de allí os juntaré: y traeros he al lugar que escogí para hacer habitar allí mi nombre.
texts.neh.1.10: Ellos pues son tus siervos y tu pueblo, los cuales redimiste con tu fortaleza grande, y con tu mano fuerte.
texts.neh.1.11: Ruego, oh Jehová, sea ahora tu oído atento a la oración de tu siervo, y a la oración de tus siervos, que desean temer tu nombre; y da ahora buen suceso hoy a tu siervo: y dále gracia delante de aquel varón. Porque era yo el copero del rey.
texts.neh.2.1: Y fue en el mes de Nisán, en el año veinte del rey Artaxerxes, el vino estaba delante de él; y tomé el vino, y di al rey: y no había estado triste delante de él.
texts.neh.2.2: Y díjome el rey: ¿Por qué es triste tu rostro, pues no estás enfermo? No es esto sino mal de corazón. Entonces temí en gran manera,
texts.neh.2.3: Y dije al rey: El rey viva para siempre: ¿por qué no será triste mi rostro, pues que la ciduad, que es casa de los sepulcros de mis padres, es desierta, y sus puertas consumidas de fuego?
texts.neh.2.4: Y díjome el rey: ¿Por qué cosa demandas? Entonces oré al Dios de los cielos,
texts.neh.2.5: Y dije al rey: Si al rey place, y si agrada tu siervo delante de ti, demando que me envíes en Judá a la ciudad de los sepulcros de mis padres, y reedificarle he.
texts.neh.2.6: Entonces el rey me dijo, (y la reina estaba sentada junto a él:) ¿Hasta cuándo será tu viaje, y cuándo volverás? Y plugo al rey, y envióme, y yo le di tiempo.
texts.neh.2.7: Y dije al rey: Si place al rey, dénseme cartas para los capitanes del otro lado del río, que me hagan pasar hasta que venga a Judá:
texts.neh.2.8: Y carta para Asaf guarda del bosque del rey, que me dé madera para enmaderar los portales del palacio de la casa, y el muro de la ciudad, y la casa donde entraré. Y dióme el rey según que era buena la mano de Jehová sobre mí.
texts.neh.2.9: Y vine a los capitanes del otro lado del río, y díles las cartas del rey: y el rey envió conmigo príncipes del ejército, y gente de a caballo.
texts.neh.2.10: Y oyéndo lo Sanaballat Horonita, y Tobías el siervo Ammonita, desplúgoles de grande desplacer, que viniese alguno para procurar el bien de los hijos de Israel.
texts.neh.2.11: Y vine a Jerusalem, y estuve allí tres días;
texts.neh.2.12: Y levantéme de noche yo, y pocos varones conmigo, y no declaré a hombre lo que Dios había puesto en mi corazón que hiciese en Jerusalem; ni había bestia conmigo, salvo la cabalgadura en que cabalgaba.
texts.neh.2.13: Y salí de noche por la puerta del valle hacia la fuente del dragón, y a la puerta del muladar: y consideré los muros de Jerusalem que estaban derribados, y sus puertas que eran consumidas del fuego.
texts.neh.2.14: Y pasé a la puerta de la fuente, y al estanque del rey: y no hubo lugar por donde pasase la bestia que estaba debajo de mí.
texts.neh.2.15: Y subí por el arroyo de noche, y consideré el muro, y volviendo entré por la puerta del valle, y volvíme.
texts.neh.2.16: Y los magistrados no supieron donde yo había ido, ni que había hecho; ni aun a los Judíos y sacerdotes, ni a los nobles y magistrados, ni a los demás que hacían la obra, hasta entonces lo había declarado.
texts.neh.2.17: Y díjeles: Vosotros veis el mal en que estamos, que Jerusalem está desierta, y sus puertas consumidas de fuego: veníd, y edifiquemos el muro de Jerusalem, y no seamos más en vergüenza.
texts.neh.2.18: Entonces les declaré la mano de mi Dios que era buena sobre mí; y asimismo las palabras del rey que me había dicho: y dijeron: Levantémosnos, y edifiquemos. Y confortaron sus manos para bien.
texts.neh.2.19: Y oyó lo Sanaballat Horonita, y Tobías el siervo Ammonita, y Gessem Árabe, y escarnecieron de nosotros, y nos despreciaron, diciendo: ¿Qué es esto que hacéis vosotros? ¿Os rebeláis contra el rey?
texts.neh.2.20: Y volvíles respuesta, y díjeles: Dios de los cielos él nos prosperará, y nosotros sus siervos nos levantaremos y edificaremos: que vosotros no tenéis parte, ni justicia, ni memoria en Jerusalem.
texts.neh.3.1: Y levantóse Eliasib el gran sacerdote, y sus hermanos los sacerdotes, y edificaron la puerta de las ovejas. Ellos aparejaron, y levantaron sus puertas hasta la torre de Meah, aparejáronla hasta la torre de Hananeel.
texts.neh.3.2: Y junto a ella edificaron los varones de Jericó: y luego edificó Zacur, hijo de Amrí.
texts.neh.3.3: Y la puerta de los peces edificaron los hijos de Hasenaa: ellos la enmaderaron, y levantaron sus puertas, y sus cerraduras, y sus cerrojos.
texts.neh.3.4: Y junto a ellos restauró Meremot, hijo de Urías, hijo de Accus: y junto a ellos restauró Mesullam, hijo de Baraquías, hijo de Mesezabel. Junto a ellos restauró Sadoc, hijo de Baana.
texts.neh.3.5: Junto a ellos restauraron los Tecuitas: mas sus grandes no metieron su cerviz a la obra de su Señor.
texts.neh.3.6: Y la puerta vieja instauraron Joiada, hijo de Pasea, y Mesullam, hijo de Besodías: ellos la enmaderaron, y levantaron sus puertas, y sus cerraduras, y sus cerrojos.
texts.neh.3.7: Junto a ellos restauró Meltiás Gabaonita, y Jadón Meronotita, varones de Gabaón y de Maspa, por la silla del capitán de la otra parte del río.
texts.neh.3.8: Y junto a ellos restauró Uziel, hijo de Harhaías, de los plateros: y junto a él instauró Jananías, hijo de Haracaim, e instauraron a Jerusalem hasta el muro ancho.
texts.neh.3.9: Y junto a ellos restauró Refaias, hijo de Jur, príncipe de la mitad de la región de Jerusalem.
texts.neh.3.10: Y junto a ellos restauró Jedaías, hijo de Haruma, y hacia su casa: y juntó a él instauró Hattus, hijo de Hasebonías.
texts.neh.3.11: La otra medida restauró Melquías, hijo de Harim, y Hasub, hijo de Pahat-moab, y la torre de los hornos.
texts.neh.3.12: Junto a él restauró Sellum, hijo de Halohes, príncipe de la mitad de la región de Jerusalem, él y sus hijas.
texts.neh.3.13: La puerta del valle restauró Hanum, y los moradores de Zanoé: ellos la reedificaron, y levantaron sus puertas, sus cerraduras, y sus cerrojos, y mil codos en el muro hasta la puerta del muladar.
texts.neh.3.14: Y la puerta del muladar reedificó Melquías, hijo de Recab, príncipe de la provincia de Betacarem: él la reedificó, y levantó sus puertas, sus cerraduras, y sus cerrojos.
texts.neh.3.15: Y la puerta de la fuente restauró Sellum, hijo de Col-hoza, príncipe de la región de Maspa: él la reedificó, y la enmaderó, y levantó sus puertas, sus cerraduras, y sus cerrojos: y el muro del estanque de Sela hacia la huerta del rey, hasta las gradas que descienden de la ciudad de David.
texts.neh.3.16: Después de él restauró Nehemías, hijo de Azbuc, príncipe de la mitad de la región de Bet-sur, hasta delante de los sepulcros de David, y hasta el estanque labrado, y hasta la casa de los valientes.
texts.neh.3.17: Tras él restauraron los Levitas, Rehum, hijo de Bani: junto a él restauró Hasabías, príncipe de la mitad de la región de Ceila, en su región.
texts.neh.3.18: Después de él restauraron sus hermanos, Banai, hijo de Henedad, príncipe de la mitad de la región de Ceila.
texts.neh.3.19: Y junto a él restauró Ezer, hijo de Jesuá, príncipe de Mispa, la otra medida delante de la subida de las armas de la esquina.
texts.neh.3.20: Después de él se encendió e instauró Baruc, hijo de Zacai, la otra medida, desde la esquina hasta la puerta de la casa de Eliasib gran sacerdote.
texts.neh.3.21: Tras él restauró Meremot, hijo de Urías, hijo de Haccus, la otra medida, desde la entrada de la casa de Eliasib hasta el cabo de la casa de Eliasib.
texts.neh.3.22: Después de él restauraron los sacerdotes, los varones de la campiña.
texts.neh.3.23: Después de él restauró Ben-jamín y Hasub, hacia su casa: y después de él instauró Azarías, hijo de Maasías, hijo de Ananías, cerca de su casa.
texts.neh.3.24: Después de él restauró Benuí, hijo de Henadad, la otra medida, desde la casa de Azarías hasta la esquina, y hasta el rincón,
texts.neh.3.25: Paal, hijo de Uzaí, delante de la esquina y la torre alta que sale de la casa del rey, que está en el patio de la cárcel: tras él Padaias, hijos de Faros.
texts.neh.3.26: Y los Natineos estuvieron en la fortaleza, hasta delante de la puerta de las aguas al oriente, y la torre que sale.
texts.neh.3.27: Después de él restauraron los Tecuitas la otra medida delante de la grande torre que sale, hasta el muro de la fortaleza.
texts.neh.3.28: Desde la puerta de los caballos restauraron los sacerdotes, cada uno delante de su casa.
texts.neh.3.29: Después de él restauró Sadoc, hijo de Immer delante de su casa: y después de él instauró Semaías, hijo de Sequenías, guarda de la puerta oriental.
texts.neh.3.30: Tras él restauró Jananías, hijo de Selemías, y Hanum el sexto hijo de Selef, la otra medida: después de él instauró Mesullam, hijo de Baraquías, delante de su cámara.
texts.neh.3.31: Después de él restauró Melquías, hijo del platero, hasta la casa de los Natineos; y los tratantes delante de la puerta del juicio, y hasta la sala de la esquina.
texts.neh.3.32: Y entre la sala de la esquina, hasta la puerta de las ovejas, restauraron los plateros y los tratantes.
texts.neh.4.1: Y fue que como oyó Sanaballat que nosotros edificábamos el muro, encendiósele la ira, y se enojó en gran manera, e hizo escarnio de los Judíos:
texts.neh.4.2: Y habló delante de sus hermanos, y del ejército de Samaria, y dijo: ¿Qué hacen estos Judíos flacos? ¿Hánles de permitir? ¿Han de sacrificar? ¿Han de acabar en un día? ¿Han de resucitar de los montones del polvo las piedras que fueron quemadas?
texts.neh.4.3: Y Tobías Ammonita estaba junto a él, el cual dijo: Aun lo que ellos edifican, si subiere una zorra, derribará su muro de piedra.
texts.neh.4.4: Oye, oh Dios nuestro, que somos en menosprecio: y vuelve la vergüenza de ellos sobre su cabeza, y dálos en presa en la tierra de su cautiverio.
texts.neh.4.5: Y no cubras su iniquidad, ni su pecado sea raído de delante de tu faz: porque se airaron contra los que edificaban.
texts.neh.4.6: Mas edificámos el muro, y toda la muralla fue junta hasta su mitad: y el pueblo tuvo ánimo para obrar.
texts.neh.4.7: Y fue, que oyendo Sanaballat, y Tobías, y los Árabes, y los Ammonitas, y los de Azoto, que los muros de Jerusalem eran curados, porque ya los portillos comenzaban a cerrarse, encendióseles la ira mucho,
texts.neh.4.8: Y conspiraron todos a una para venir a combatir a Jerusalem, y hacerle daño.
texts.neh.4.9: Entonces orámos a nuestro Dios y pusimos guardia sobre ellos de día y de noche, por causa de ellos.
texts.neh.4.10: Y dijo Judá: Las fuerzas de los que llevan son enflaquecidas, y la tierra es mucha, y no podemos edificar el muro.
texts.neh.4.11: Y nuestros enemigos dijeron: No sepan, ni vean, hasta que entremos en medio de ellos, y los matemos, y hagamos cesar la obra.
texts.neh.4.12: Y fue que como vinieron los Judíos que habitaban entre ellos, nos dieron aviso diez veces de todos los lugares donde volvían a nosotros.
texts.neh.4.13: Entonces puse por los bajos del lugar detrás del muro, y en las alturas de los peñascos puse el pueblo por familias, con sus espadas, con sus lanzas, y con sus arcos.
texts.neh.4.14: ¶ Y miré, y levantéme, y dije a los principales, y a los magistrados, y al resto del pueblo: No temáis delante de ellos: del Señor grande y terrible os acordád; y peleád por vuestros hermanos, por vuestros hijos, y por vuestras hijas, por vuestras mujeres, y por vuestras casas.
texts.neh.4.15: Y fue que como oyeron nuestros enemigos que lo entendimos, Dios disipó su consejo, y nos volvimos todos al muro cada uno a su obra.
texts.neh.4.16: Mas fue, que desde aquel día la mitad de los mancebos hacían en la obra, y la otra mitad de ellos tenía lanzas, y escudos, y arcos, y corazas; y los príncipes estaban tras toda la casa de Judá.
texts.neh.4.17: Los que edificaban en el muro, y los que llevaban cargas, y los que cargaban, con la una mano hacían en la obra, y en la otra tenían la espada.
texts.neh.4.18: Porque los que edificaban, cada uno tenía su espada ceñida sobre sus lomos, y así edificaban: y el que tocaba la trompeta estaba junto a mí.
texts.neh.4.19: Y dije a los principales, y a los magistrados, y al resto del pueblo: La obra es grande y larga, y nosotros estamos apartados en el muro lejos los unos de los otros:
texts.neh.4.20: En el lugar donde oyereis la voz de la trompeta, allí os juntaréis a nosotros: nuestro Dios peleará por nosotros.
texts.neh.4.21: Y nosotros hacíamos en la obra; y la mitad de ellos tenía lanzas desde la subida del alba hasta salir las estrellas.
texts.neh.4.22: También entonces dije al pueblo: Cada uno con su criado se quede dentro de Jerusalem, y nos hagan de noche centinela, y de día a la obra.
texts.neh.4.23: Y ni yo, ni mis hermanos, ni mis mozos, ni la gente de guardia que me seguía, desnudamos nuestro vestido: cada uno se desnudaba solamente a las aguas.
texts.neh.5.1: Entonces fue el clamor del pueblo y de sus mujeres grande contra los Judíos sus hermanos.
texts.neh.5.2: Y había quien decía: Nuestros hijos, y nuestras hijas, y nosotros, somos muchos: y hemos comprado grano para comer y vivir.
texts.neh.5.3: Y había otros que decían: Nuestras tierras, y nuestras viñas, y nuestras casas hemos empeñado, para comprar grano en la hambre.
texts.neh.5.4: Y había otros que decían: Hemos tomado emprestado dinero para el tributo del rey sobre nuestras tierras y nuestras viñas.
texts.neh.5.5: Y ahora como la carne de nuestros hermanos es nuestra carne, como sus hijos son también nuestros hijos: y, he aquí que nosotros sujetamos nuestros hijos y nuestras hijas en servidumbre, y hay algunas de nuestras hijas sujetas, y no hay facultad en nuestras manos para rescatarlas; y nuestras tierras y nuestras viñas son de otros.
texts.neh.5.6: Y enojéme en gran manera, cuando oí su clamor y estas palabras.
texts.neh.5.7: Y pensó mi corazón en mí, y reprendí a los principales, y a los magistrados, y díjeles: ¿Usura tomáis cada uno de vuestros hermanos? E hice contra ellos una grande junta,
texts.neh.5.8: Y díjeles: Nosotros rescatamos a nuestros hermanos Judíos, que eran vendidos a las gentes, conforme a la facultad que había en nosotros: ¿y vosotros aun vendéis a vuestros hermanos, y serán vendidos a nosotros? Y callaron, que no tuvieron que responder.
texts.neh.5.9: Y dije: No es bien lo que hacéis: ¿No andaréis en temor de nuestro Dios por la vergüenza de las gentes nuestras enemigas?
texts.neh.5.10: Y también yo, y mis hermanos, y mis criados les habemos prestado dinero y grano: soltémosles ahora esta usura.
texts.neh.5.11: Ruégoos que les volváis hoy sus tierras, sus viñas, sus olivares, y sus casas, y la centésima parte del dinero, y del grano, del vino, y del aceite que demandáis de ellos.
texts.neh.5.12: Y dijeron: Volveremos, y no les demandaremos: así haremos, como tú dices. Entonces convoqué los sacerdotes, y les juramenté que hiciesen conforme a esto.
texts.neh.5.13: Además de esto sacudí mi vestido, y dije: Así sacuda Dios de su casa y de su trabajo a todo varón que no cumpliere esto, y así sea sacudido y vacío. Y respondió toda la congregación: Amén: y alabaron a Jehová: e hizo el pueblo conforme a esto.
texts.neh.5.14: También desde el día que me mandó el rey que fuese capitán de ellos en la tierra de Judá, desde el año veinte del rey Artaxerxes hasta el año treinta y dos, doce años, ni yo ni mis hermanos comimos el pan del capitán.
texts.neh.5.15: Mas los primeros capitanes que fueron antes de mí, cargaron al pueblo, y tomaron de ellos por el pan y por el vino sobre cuarenta pesos de plata; además de esto, sus criados se enseñoreaban sobre el pueblo; mas yo no hice así a causa del temor de Dios.
texts.neh.5.16: Además de esto, en la obra de este muro instauré mi parte, ni compramos heredad: y todos mis criados juntos estaban allí a la obra.
texts.neh.5.17: Ítem, los Judíos y los magistrados, ciento y cincuenta varones, y los que venían a nosotros de las gentes que están en nuestros al derredores, estaban a mi mesa.
texts.neh.5.18: Y lo que se aderezaba para cada día era un buey, y seis ovejas escogidas; y aves también se aparejaban para mí: y cada diez días vino en toda abundancia: y con todo esto nunca busqué el pan del capitán, porque la servidumbre de este pueblo era grave.
texts.neh.5.19: Acuérdate de mí para bien, Dios mío, y de todo lo que hice a este pueblo.
texts.neh.6.1: Y fue que como oyó Sanaballat, y Tobías, y Gessem el Árabe, y los demás nuestros enemigos, que había edificado el muro, y que no quedaba portillo en él, aunque hasta este tiempo no había puesto puertas en las portadas;
texts.neh.6.2: Envió Sanaballat y Gessem a mí, diciendo: Ven, y concertarnos hemos juntos en las aldeas en el campo de Ono. Mas ellos habían pensado hacerme mal.
texts.neh.6.3: Y enviéles mensajeros, diciendo: Yo hago una grande obra, y no puedo venir: porque cesará la obra dejándola yo para venir a vosotros.
texts.neh.6.4: Y enviaron a mí de esta misma manera por cuatro veces, y yo les respondí de la misma manera.
texts.neh.6.5: Y envió a mí Sanaballat de la misma manera la quinta vez su criado con la carta abierta en su mano,
texts.neh.6.6: En la cual era escrito: En las gentes se ha oído, y Gasmu dice, que tú y los Judíos pensáis rebelaros; y que por eso edificas tú el muro, y tú eres su rey según estas palabras:
texts.neh.6.7: Y que has puesto profetas que prediquen de ti en Jerusalem, diciendo: Rey en Judá. Y ahora serán oídas del rey las palabras semejantes: por tanto ven, y consultemos juntamente.
texts.neh.6.8: Entonces yo envié a él, diciendo: No hay tal cosa como dices; que de tu corazón lo inventas tú.
texts.neh.6.9: Porque todos ellos nos ponen miedo, diciendo: Debilitarse han las manos de ellos en la obra, y no será hecha. Esfuerza pues mis manos.
texts.neh.6.10: Y vine a casa de Semaías, hijo de Dalaías, hijo de Metabeel en secreto, porque él estaba encarcelado, el cual dijo: Juntémosnos en la casa de Dios, dentro el templo, y cerremos las puertas del templo; porque vienen para matarte, y esta noche vendrán para matarte.
texts.neh.6.11: Entonces dije: ¿Varón como yo ha de huir? ¿Y quién hay como yo que entre al templo y viva? No entraré.
texts.neh.6.12: Y entendí que Dios no le había enviado: mas que hablaba aquella profecía contra mí, y que Tobías o Sanaballat, le había alquilado por salario.
texts.neh.6.13: Porque alquilado fue para hacerme temer así, y que pecase, y fuése a ellos por mala nombradía, para que yo fuese avergonzado.
texts.neh.6.14: Acuérdate, Dios mío, de Tobías y de Sanaballat conforme a estas sus obras: y también de Noadías profetisa, y de los otros profetas que me ponían miedo.
texts.neh.6.15: Acabóse pues el muro a los veinte y cinco de Elul, en cincuenta y dos días.
texts.neh.6.16: Y como lo oyeron todos nuestros enemigos, temieron todas las gentes que estaban en nuestros al derredores, y cayeron mucho en sus ojos, y conocieron que por nuestro Dios había sido hecha esta obra.
texts.neh.6.17: Asimismo en aquellos días, de los principales de Judá iban muchas cartas a Tobías, y las de Tobías venían a ellos:
texts.neh.6.18: Porque muchos en Judá habían conjurado con él; porque era yerno de Sequenías, hijo de Area; y Johanán su hijo había tomado la hija de Mosollam, hijo de Baraquías.
texts.neh.6.19: También contaban delante de mí sus buenas obras, y a él recitaban mis palabras. Cartas envió Tobías para atemorizarme.
texts.neh.7.1: Y fue, que como el muro fue edificado, y asenté las puertas, y fueron señalados porteros, y cantores, y Levitas,
texts.neh.7.2: Mandé a Janani mi hermano, y a Jananías príncipe del palacio en Jerusalem: porque este era, como varón de verdad y temeroso de Dios, sobre muchos:
texts.neh.7.3: Y díjeles: No se abran las puertas de Jerusalem hasta que el sol caliente: y aun ellos presentes, cierren las puertas, y atrancád. Y señalé guardias de los moradores de Jerusalem, cada uno en su guardia, y cada uno delante de su casa.
texts.neh.7.4: ¶ Y la ciudad era ancha de espacio y grande, y poco pueblo dentro de ella; que no había aun casas edificadas.
texts.neh.7.5: Mas puso Dios en mi corazón que juntase los principales, y los magistrados, y el pueblo, para que fuesen empadronados por el orden de los linajes; y hallé el libro de la genealogía de los que habían subido antes, y hallé escrito en él:
texts.neh.7.6: Estos son los hijos de la provincia, que subieron de la cautividad de la transmigración, que hizo pasar Nabucodonosor rey de Babilonia, los cuales volvieron a Jerusalem y a Judá, cada uno a su ciudad.
texts.neh.7.7: Los cuales vinieron con Zorobabel, Jesuá, Nehemías, Azarías, Raamías, Nahamani, Mardoqueo, Bilsán, Misperet, Biguai, Nehum, Baana. La cuenta de los varones del pueblo de Israel:
texts.neh.7.8: Los hijos de Faros, dos mil y ciento y setenta y dos.
texts.neh.7.9: Los hijos de Safatías, trescientos y setenta y dos.
texts.neh.7.10: Los hijos de Area, seiscientos y cincuenta y dos.
texts.neh.7.11: Los hijos de Pahat-moab, de los hijos de Jesuá, y de Joab, dos mil y ochocientos y diez y ocho.
texts.neh.7.12: Los hijos de Elam, mil y doscientos y cincuenta y cuatro.
texts.neh.7.13: Los hijos de Zattu, ochocientos y cuarenta y cinco.
texts.neh.7.14: Los hijos de Zecai, setecientos y sesenta.
texts.neh.7.15: Los hijos de Binui, seiscientos y cuarenta y ocho.
texts.neh.7.16: Los hijos de Bebai, seiscientos y veinte y ocho.
texts.neh.7.17: Los hijos de Azgad, dos mil y seiscientos y veinte y dos.
texts.neh.7.18: Los hijos de Adonicam, seiscientos y sesenta y siete.
texts.neh.7.19: Los hijos de Biguai, dos mil y sesenta y siete.
texts.neh.7.20: Los hijos de Addín, seiscientos y cincuenta y cinco.
texts.neh.7.21: Los hijos de Ater, de Ezequías, noventa y ocho.
texts.neh.7.22: Los hijos de Hasum, trescientos y veinte y ocho.
texts.neh.7.23: Los hijos de Besaí, trescientos y veinte y cuatro.
texts.neh.7.24: Los hijos de Harif, ciento y doce.
texts.neh.7.25: Los hijos de Gabaón, noventa y cinco.
texts.neh.7.26: Los varones de Belén y de Netofa, ciento y ochenta y ocho.
texts.neh.7.27: Los varones de Anatot, ciento y veinte y ocho.
texts.neh.7.28: Los varones de Bet-azmavet, cuarenta y dos.
texts.neh.7.29: Los varones de Cariat-jarim, Quefira y Beerot, setecientos y cuarenta y tres.
texts.neh.7.30: Los varones de Rama y de Gabaa, seiscientos y veinte y uno.
texts.neh.7.31: Los varones de Macmas, ciento y veinte y dos.
texts.neh.7.32: Los varones de Bet-el y de Ai, ciento y veinte y tres.
texts.neh.7.33: Los varones de la otra Nebo, cincuenta y dos.
texts.neh.7.34: Los hijos de la otra Elam, mil y doscientos y cincuenta y cuatro.
texts.neh.7.35: Los hijos de Harim, trescientos y veinte.
texts.neh.7.36: Los hijos de Jericó, trescientos y cuarenta y cinco.
texts.neh.7.37: Los hijos de Lod, Hadid, y de Ono, siete cientos y veinte y uno.
texts.neh.7.38: Los hijos de Senaa, tres mil y novecientos y treinta.
texts.neh.7.39: Sacerdotes: Los hijos de Jedaias de la casa de Jesuá, novecientos y setenta y tres.
texts.neh.7.40: Los hijos de Immer, mil y cincuenta y dos.
texts.neh.7.41: Los hijos de Fasur, mil y doscientos y cuarenta y siete.
texts.neh.7.42: Los hijos de Harim, mil y diez y siete.
texts.neh.7.43: Levitas: Los hijos de Jesuá, de Cadmiel, de los hijos de Odvia, setenta y cuatro.
texts.neh.7.44: Cantores: Los hijos de Asaf, ciento y cuarenta y ocho.
texts.neh.7.45: Porteros: Los hijos de Sellum, los hijos de Ater, los hijos de Talmón, los hijos de Accub, los hijos de Hatita, los hijos de Sobai, ciento y treinta y ocho.
texts.neh.7.46: Natineos: Los hijos de Siha, los hijos de Hasufa, los hijos de Tabaot,
texts.neh.7.47: Los hijos de Ceros, los hijos de Sea, los hijos de Padón,
texts.neh.7.48: Los hijos de Lebana, los hijos de Hagaba, los hijos de Salmai,
texts.neh.7.49: Los hijos de Hanán, los hijos de Giddel, los hijos de Gahar,
texts.neh.7.50: Los hijos de Reaia, los hijos de Resín, los hijos de Necoda,
texts.neh.7.51: Los hijos de Gazzam, los hijos de Uzza, los hijos de Fasea,
texts.neh.7.52: Los hijos de Besai, los hijos de Meunim, los hijos de Nefisesim,
texts.neh.7.53: Los hijos de Bacbuc, los hijos de Hacufa, los hijos de Harur,
texts.neh.7.54: Los hijos de Baslit, los hijos de Mehida, los hijos de Harsa,
texts.neh.7.55: Los hijos de Barcos, los hijos de Sísera, los hijos de Tama,
texts.neh.7.56: Los hijos de Nesia, los hijos de Hatifa.
texts.neh.7.57: Los hijos de los siervos de Salomón: los hijos de Sotai, los hijos de Soforet, los hijos de Perida,
texts.neh.7.58: Los hijos de Jaala, los hijos de Darcón, los hijos de Giddel,
texts.neh.7.59: Los hijos de Safatías, los hijos de Hatil, los hijos de Poqueret de Hasbaim, los hijos de Amón.
texts.neh.7.60: Todos los Natineos, e hijos de los siervos de Salomón, trescientos y noventa y dos.
texts.neh.7.61: Y estos son los que subieron de Tel-mela, Tel-harsa, Querub, Addón, e Immer, los cuales no pudieron mostrar la casa de sus padres, y su linaje, si eran de Israel:
texts.neh.7.62: Los hijos de Delaia, los hijos de Tobías, los hijos de Necoda, seiscientos y cuarenta y dos.
texts.neh.7.63: Y de los sacerdotes: los hijos de Hobaias, los hijos de Haccos, los hijos de Berzellai, que tomó mujer de las hijas de Berzellai Galaadita, y se llamó del nombre de ellas.
texts.neh.7.64: Estos buscaron su escritura de genealogías, y no fueron hallados, y fueron echados del sacerdocio.
